The [[Deldrimor Axe (unique)|Deldrimor Axe]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[axe]] traded by the [[Artisan of Steel]], a [[collector]] who can be found in [[Droknar's Forge (explorable area)]].

== Stats ==
: [[Slashing damage|Slashing Dmg]]: 6-28 (Requires 9 [[Axe Mastery]])
: [[Damage]] +15% (while [[Health]] is above 50%)
: [[Armor penetration]] +20% (Chance: 20%)
: [[Health]] +30

==Skin==
This item uses the same skin as the non-unique [[Deldrimor Axe]].

== Replica ==
It is possible to create an exact replica for this item with:
*[[Deldrimor Axe]] from crafter [[Grand Mason Stonecleaver]]
*[[Perfect]] [[Sundering]] [[Axe Haft]]
*[[Perfect]] [[Axe Grip]] [[of Fortitude]]
*[[Perfect]] "[[Inscription|Strength and Honor]]" inscription
